# 7-Zip Windows x64 Console Bundle

SumaFile bundles the x64 console files from the official 7-Zip Extra package:

- Version: 26.03
- Release date: 2026-09-03
- Source: https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.03/7z2603-extra.7z
- Upstream download page: https://www.7-zip.org/download.html

The files copied into release payloads are:

- `7za.exe`
- `7za.dll`
- `7zxa.dll`
- `License.txt`
- `readme.txt`

Keep `License.txt` with the binary files in SumaFile release artifacts.
